verdict.rationale: Amplitude's own docs say it runs A/B, multivariate and bandit tests, and that it can 'measure causal lift' and ship the winning variant. That covers the core of running experiments and judging an outcome. However, the docs never explicitly describe defining goal metrics or reporting statistical significance on results. missing for 10: explicit goal/primary metric configuration, documented statistical significance or confidence reporting on results, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can run A/B experiments with goal metrics and statistical significance reported on the results

citations.quote: Run A/B, multivariate, and bandit tests so the data, not the loudest opinion, makes the call.
Test variants, target segments, measure causal lift.
ship the winning variant without a code deploy
Roll out behind a flag and run A/B tests so the data, not a hunch, drives the release.
